question: How many heritage cities have been selected for rejuvenation and development under National Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana (HRIDAY)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 heritage cities**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **12 heritage cities** have been selected for rejuvenation and development under the National Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana (HRIDAY).
 
• The HRIDAY scheme aims to preserve and revitalize the unique character of each heritage city.
